mentions.name: Text Message Reminders
mentions.description: A text-message reminder automation service: users text the service number a request like "call Dave in 2 hours", and the service sends back a reminder text at that scheduled time. Currently in private beta.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Text message reminders and automation.

Send the service number a text message like "call Dave in 2 hours"

and then in 2 hours you get a text back that says "call Dave"
mentions.author: reidjs
